note: Polyurethane two-part reagent descriptor stage (lower/nano band). Consumes the Geant4-probed solution and freshly-mixed resin densities and electron density (Geant4 sees the isocyanate nitrogen and the A/B density contrast) plus the declared two-part recipe (polyol hydroxyl number, water pphp, isocyanate index, amine catalyst, silicone surfactant, initial temperature) and produces dimensionless mechanistic descriptors: urethane-formation drive, water-blowing drive, exotherm capacity, cross-link functionality, surfactant film stabilisation, and a temperature deviation factor. Inputs are standardised (input_mean/input_std) so the operating envelope is explicit. The exotherm/urethane descriptors carry the Geant4 density/electron-density anchors so the response is tied to the real constructed material base, not just the recipe. This stage emits no expansion ratio, milestone time, colour, or final consistency; those emerge downstream from the integrated dual-reaction foaming model. It is an illustrative response surface (no measured hull); a wider trained reactive-foam panel is tracked in ROADMAP.md.
